items.headline: $ZETA Ditches Its Own Chain, Migrates to Solana
items.summary: ZetaChain governance voted to sunset its L1 and move $ZETA to Solana, pivoting focus to its private AI app Anuma. One more vote is needed to finalize.

items.headline: $POLY Hit by $10M Fraud Attempt, 500 Accounts Hacked
items.summary: Polymarket faced a $10M fraud attempt while its CEO pushed growth over compliance, per WSJ. Hackers also compromised nearly 500 user accounts with stolen personal data.

items.headline: $SHIB Sees 144B Exchange Netflow Despite 5% Rally
items.summary: A massive 144 billion $SHIB netflow to exchanges is flashing warning signs even as the memecoin posts a 5% price rally. Whales may be preparing to sell.

items.headline: $POL Burn: Polygon to Destroy 100M Tokens Forever
items.summary: Polygon announced a permanent burn of 100 million $POL tokens, a major supply cut that could tighten tokenomics and spark fresh momentum for the ecosystem.

items.headline: $ADA Treasury Vote: Hoskinson Says Cardano Comes Second
items.summary: Charles Hoskinson admitted Cardano no longer comes first as a key treasury vote unfolds, stirring debate over $ADA's priorities and future direction.
